comment: The shelved ion's telegraph as the characterising experiment of the click's round (the owner's word of 2026-10-02, about 11:00 Israel, 'Yes to the experiment', on the Boss's proposal of 10:50; HIGHLIGHTS.md, the lines of 10:48, 11:00 and 11:20; the two hands' design: the mathematician's 138, #1572 comment 5947659375, the telegraph as three clicks under the owner's line of 131 to 137, and the advisor's blind, #1572 comment 5947666040 section 4, corrected by his 5948063089 section 1, the shelving rate Zeno-limited; nature: Bergquist, Hulet, Itano and Wineland 1986, the telegraph of one Hg+ ion, 30 or 0 counts per 10 ms with the dark mean 0.09 s, and Itano, Heinzen, Bollinger and Wineland 1990, the Zeno-limited rate). Every number of the two worlds and of the blind stands in this file; the engine reads none of it. The folder holds the universe file `mercury_ion.json`, the world `shelved_ion.json`, its control `shelved_ion_control.json` and the blind `expectation.json`, written before any lay and any run, and no builder: the world is laid by no generator of main (status below) and the files were written by hand from this design, every key a declaration. TWO HYPOTHESES OF THE TEST WORLD UNDER THEIR OWN NAMES, declarations of the files and nothing in the engine (the owner's word of 11:00): (1) THE MODES AS LABELS (the mathematician's 124, declaration 1, #1572 comment 5946705567): the ion's family has the parts shape [3, 2], three planes laid as one event and never summed at a Node, the part the body's label, S (the ground mode), P (the excited mode the strong drive feeds) and D (the metastable shelf the weak drive feeds); the three shapes are laid by the file at interval 0 (the `parts` key of the body, S with the count 1, P and D with 0), the parts sharing one pair and so one rest rotation, so that the energy of a transition is not the board's and the quantum a part gives is laid at the frequency of the drive that fed the transition (the lay's balance per branch, 126 (2): the given light's frequency is the drive's); the atom's spectrum is not solved by the labels (124, what it does not solve) and this world asks nothing of it. (2) THE GIVING AT A DECLARED RATE (the mathematician's 126 (1), the floor; 128 B, 'a fifth act under its own name'; the owner's decision of 10:20 and his word of 10:20 on the Node level, HIGHLIGHTS.md): a quantum standing in an excited part is given to the light at the declared rate 1 / lifetime per interval (the `rates` key of the body), the exponential by construction and the rate one number read from nature until a derivation; the fluorescence P -> S at 1 / tau_P and the return D -> S at 1 / tau_D. THE BODY AS A NODEREADER (the act of branch click-ends, the advisor's form at the owner's word of 10:20, two hands with 138): the body takes a quantum of a drive at the two-mode line's share and is re-laid in the realised part over its own Nodes with its whole count, the other parts 0 there (the shelving: the weak drive's quantum taken, the ion re-laid in D); it gives a quantum at the declared rate, laying one whole quantum of light at its shell Node on the row the body names (`gives_to`) and re-laying itself in the lower part (the fluorescence: P -> S, the light on the row `fluorescence`; the return: D -> S, the light on the weak drive's own row, the frequency the drive's); every draw with the file's seed, the run deterministic per seed. THE WORLD: a periodic box of 12 x 12 x 7 Nodes on the universe `mercury_ion.json` (no holder of the content, as the nuclide's universe: the ion is one quantum and its content well is nothing); the ion one quantum of the family `ion` at the near-flat pair [1, 1299] (the toy atom's heavy family on branch toy-worlds, cos omega = 1 / 1299, the band's inertia m* = 3 tan omega = 3,897: nature's ion is 200 times a nucleon and held by its trap; here it is held by its inertia and re-laid at its declared Nodes at every click, spreading between clicks by t / (2 m*), 0.10 Links over a dark period of tau_D = 800) at the two centre Nodes [6, 6, 4] and [7, 6, 4], its shell Nodes themselves; two drives as two holders of the sign under the act `rotation` (ALGEBRA.md, The sign holder rotates the two-part record; The turn per proper interval), each a plane wave of its own row laid by the message lay over the whole box on a periodic axis, so that it circulates for the whole run with its amplitude at the ion constant: `strong_drive` along x at k = pi / 2 and the amplitude 3,000, the S <-> P drive, saturating, and `weak_drive` along y at k = pi / 2 and the amplitude 53, the S -> D drive; a third holder of the sign, `fluorescence`, carrying no drive, on which the P -> S quantum is laid, so that the counter reads the fluorescence apart from the drives (a counter reading the drive's own row would write its hole into the drive at every click); one counter, `fluorescence_counter`, every Node of the box but the ion's two, so that every given quantum enters it within a few intervals through the ion's two Nodes' ten outer Ports (nature's counter sees a solid angle of about 10^-4 of the fluorescence; here the whole of it, and the counts per bin are the quanta given per bin), with the `draw` key as branch click-ends declares it (the window B = 320 intervals, the seed 24, the generator x <- (multiplier x + increment) mod 2^width with the gate worlds' two integers and the width the universe file's 63); no face recedes: a drain by a receding face grows the board at light's pace, 0.45 Links per interval at k = pi / 2, and ends the run at the axis's largest size within a few hundred intervals of a run of 96,000, so the box is periodic and a given quantum, once credited (the count down by one in the credit's accounting, the levels at one Node taken), stays on the board as an empty wave, uncreditable, its share at the ion's Node at most the accumulated share over the box's 1,008 Nodes (`fence`). THE BLIND in the law's names (expectation.json, written before any run; re-derived at the law's floor tau_P = 8 by the two hands at the frozen engine, #1793 comments 5981514001 and 5981478790): the fluorescence rate R = share_P / tau_P per interval, the P part's mean share under the strong drive at the level 3,000 the two-mode line's s / (2 (1 + s)) = 0.4848 at the saturation s = 2 (Omega_s tau_P)^2 = 32 (the saturated one half, R = 1 / (2 tau_P) = 0.0625, beside it), so R = 0.0606 and the counts per bin of B intervals in a bright period are Poisson with the mean B R = 19.4; the shelving rate Zeno-limited, Omega_w^2 / R, with Omega_w the weak drive's Rabi rate in the law's units, k_r ell_w / Gamma times the two modes' overlap (the weak light's level at the body, 53, over Gamma, the read weight 1 and the overlap 1 since the parts' shapes are alike), so the bright periods are exponential with the mean R / Omega_w^2 = 777 intervals (the shelving rate Omega_w^2 / R = 1.29 x 10^-3 per interval); the return at 1 / tau_D, the dark periods exponential with the mean tau_D = 800; the dark fraction tau_D / (tau_D + R / Omega_w^2) = 0.507; the counts per bin BIMODAL, two peaks, at 19.4 and at 0; the control, the same world on today's engine with no draw and no body's click, unimodal (0 in every bin: a steady rotation writes no beat and no quantum is given without the act; the law as written before the write, the giving drawn from the shares without the re-lay, 128's verdict, unimodal Poisson at the mean rate). The ratios kept: B = 40 tau_P (320 against 8, about 20 counts per bright bin, the design's rule), B under tau_D and R / Omega_w^2 (320 against 800 and 777, 2.5 bins per period), tau_D about R / Omega_w^2 (800 against 777, the dark fraction one half), the run 61 (tau_D + R / Omega_w^2) = 96,000 intervals, 300 bins, about 61 switches; the bin over the dark mean 0.40 against nature's 10 ms over 90 ms. Laid by the generator (the mode files beside the worlds), admitted by the loader; run once at the frozen hash by the experimenter against this blind.

ion.what: the ion, three planes as one event, the parts the labels S, P, D

weak_drive.what: the S -> D drive's row, its record the weak light; the return's quantum is laid on it

level_at_the_node.formula: one quantum's Wronskian W = T / 2 = A^2 sin omega

parts.name: P
parts.role: excited, fed by the strong drive, gives to the fluorescence at 1 / tau_P

parts.name: D
parts.role: metastable shelf, fed by the weak drive, gives to the weak drive's row at 1 / tau_D

ion.shapes: the three parts' shapes alike, the one Node's standing record of one quantum (the symmetric lay, GameBoard.lay), the labels alone telling them apart

overlap.why: the two modes' overlap in Omega's formula; the shapes alike, the overlap is 1

ion.shell_node: the ion's two Nodes, [6, 6, 4] and [7, 6, 4], the given quantum laid at one of them drawn by the record's share
ion.re_lay: at every click the realised part is laid over the body's declared Node in the declared shape with the whole count, the other parts 0 there (138; the trap's hold)

turn_per_interval.formula: theta = 2 arctan((L p_0 / Gamma) / (2 Gamma)) at p_0 = Gamma

rabi_rate_per_interval.formula: Omega_s = k_r ell_s / Gamma x overlap

saturation.formula: s = 2 (Omega_s tau_P)^2; the P part's mean share s / (2 (1 + s)), one half at s much above 1

quanta_laid_about.formula: 2 A^2 (1 - cos omega) / T per Node, over the box

strong_drive.guards: the level 3,000 under the rotation guard's 2 Gamma = 12,000 and the amplitude bound 9,264; the tangent half-angle 0.25

turn_per_interval.formula: theta = 2 arctan((L p_0 / Gamma) / (2 Gamma)) at p_0 = Gamma

rabi_rate_per_interval.formula: Omega_w = k_r ell_w / Gamma x overlap, k_r = 1, overlap 1

quanta_laid_about.formula: 2 A^2 (1 - cos omega) / T per Node, over the box

weak_drive.count_over_the_run: down by one per shelving, up by one per return laid on this row, down by one where the counter credits the return: about 61 less at the end of about 66 by this accounting at the run's 61 cycles (30 of 66 at the design's tau_D = 1,600), each taking the levels at one Node, 0.06 of a quantum; the level at the body is row 10's blind

drives.why_plane_waves_on_periodic_axes: a packet passes the ion in tens of intervals and the engine has no source; a plane wave on a periodic axis circulates for the run with its amplitude at the ion constant, and its net inflow through any region is 0 but for the rounding (the share of a plane wave is uniform and constant), so the counter credits none of it

P_to_S.what: the fluorescence, the strong transition's; nature's 2P lifetime 2.3 ns

D_to_S.what: the return from the shelf; nature's tau_D = 0.09 s (Bergquist 1986)

body_node_reader.what: the body's own draw per interval (the rates are per interval), the generator the gate worlds', its seed its own; the act may read the world's generator instead, named

counter.name: fluorescence_counter
counter.positions: every Node of the box but the ion's two, 1,006 Nodes, one connected region (periodic), its front the two Nodes' ten outer Ports
counter.reads: every family of quanta, as every detector of main does; the blind reads its `fluorescence` lines and, beside them, its `weak_drive` lines (the returns)
counter.collection: the whole of every given quantum within a few intervals (light's pace 0.45 Links per interval, the box wrapping at 6 Links along x and y, no wave along z)

R_per_interval.formula: share_P / tau_P, the P part's mean share s / (2 (1 + s)) at the declared saturation s = 2 (Omega_s tau_P)^2 = 32

shelving_rate_per_interval.formula: Omega_w^2 / R, Zeno-limited (the advisor's 5948063089 section 1; Itano 1990)

quanta_given_over_the_run_about.formula: ticks x (1 - dark fraction) x R

ratios.asked: B = 40 tau_P, about 20 counts per bright bin (the advisor's floor); B under tau_D and R / Omega_w^2, 2.5 bins per period; tau_D about R / Omega_w^2, the dark fraction one half; the run about 61 (tau_D + R / Omega_w^2) (the advisor's 5947666040 section 4 and 5948063089 section 1, re-derived at tau_P = 8 by the two hands at the frozen engine, #1793 comments 5981514001 and 5981478790)

choices_and_reasons.tau_P = 8: the law's floor: the span condition (ALGEBRA.md, The span condition) admits no lifetime under 8 at the resonance [2, 3], num / den <= cos(2 pi / tau), the loader refusing 4 by name; Omega_s tau_P = 4 at the level 3,000, s = 32, the P share 0.485
choices_and_reasons.B = 320: 40 tau_P, 19.4 counts per bright bin, the design's rule of about 20 (the advisor's floor); 0.40 of tau_D against nature's 10 ms bin at 0.11 of 0.09 s
choices_and_reasons.tau_D = 800: about R / Omega_w^2 = 777 at the weak level 53, the dark fraction 0.507 (at 1,600 it would be 0.67), both periods seen; 2.5 bins
choices_and_reasons.A_w = 53: Omega_w = 53 / 6000 gives R / Omega_w^2 = 777 at R = 0.0606, about tau_D's 800; and the weak drive's about 66 quanta over the box against the run's about 61 shelvings
choices_and_reasons.A_s = 3000: half Gamma: the turn 0.49 per interval under the tangent half-angle guard, s = 32 at tau_P = 8, the P share 0.485 against the saturated one half, both written
choices_and_reasons.k = pi / 2: the wavelength 4 Links divides the box's 12 along x and y, so each plane wave wraps exactly on its periodic axis; the house's pi / 4 (the wavelength 8) would need a box of 16 and twice the cost, and the weak drive's count per Node, 2 A^2 (1 - cos omega) / T, is largest at a large k (1 - cos omega = 1 / 3 at pi / 2 against 0.098 at pi / 4), so the box holds about 66 weak quanta for the run's about 61 shelvings
choices_and_reasons.ticks = 96000: 61 (tau_D + R / Omega_w^2); 300 bins; about 61 bright and 61 dark periods
choices_and_reasons.shape = [12, 12, 7]: 1,008 Nodes, 0.97 x 10^8 Node-intervals, minutes at the engine's pace (the two slits' 2.8 x 10^5 in a few seconds); the drives along x and y at 12, a multiple of the wavelength 4, and no wave along z; the box wraps at 6 Links from the ion along x and y
choices_and_reasons.the ion's pair [1, 1299]: the heaviest pair the house has laid (the toy atom's core): the ion spreads 0.10 Links over a dark period and 0.04 over a window, so its own share entering the adjacent counter per window, under 10^-3 of a quantum, credits nothing
choices_and_reasons.two Nodes: the shell Nodes are the body's two; the three shapes alike; the counter adjacent
choices_and_reasons.no holder of the content: one quantum's well is nothing; the nuclide's precedent
choices_and_reasons.three holders of the sign: the fluorescence apart from the drives, so the counter's hole is written on the fluorescence row alone; the ion reads all three under the rotation and sources each statically by its Wronskian (W = T / 2 per quantum, a static level around one Node, a fraction of a level at the level weight 1)
choices_and_reasons.periodic, no receding face: see the comment: a drain grows the board without bound over a long run; the accumulated empty waves are the fence of the bright bins' width
choices_and_reasons.the window of the counter = the bin: the credit draws at the window's end; a bin is a window

wave_fit: a plane wave on a periodic axis wraps exactly where the axis's extent is a multiple of its wavelength: the wave [1, 2] has the wavelength 4 and the box is 12 x 12 x 7, so the strong drive along x (12) and the weak drive along y (12) fit; no wave runs along z, so the odd extent 7 fits nothing and breaks nothing (the drives along x and y, 12 a multiple of the wavelength 4)

nature.Bergquist_Hulet_Itano_Wineland_1986: Phys. Rev. Lett. 57, 1699: one Hg+ ion, the 194 nm S-P fluorescence under a saturating drive, the 282 nm S-D weak drive, 30 or 0 counts per 10 ms bin, bright and dark periods, tau_D = 0.09 s
nature.Itano_Heinzen_Bollinger_Wineland_1990: Phys. Rev. A 41, 2295: the quantum Zeno effect, the weak transition's rate limited by the strong transition's resets, Omega_w^2 / R in form
nature.Cook_Kimble_1985: Phys. Rev. Lett. 54, 1023: the telegraph's statistics from rate equations, exponential periods
nature.scaling: the engine's intervals compress nature's: tau_P / B is 2.3 x 10^-7 in nature and 0.025 here; B / tau_D 0.11 and 0.40

the re-lay in the declared shape at the declared Node (`nodes`), the other parts 0 there, so that the body does not walk over 96,000 intervals (nature's trap)

the saturated S <-> P exchange: the P part's mean share under the strong drive, one half at full saturation (R = 1 / (2 tau_P)); with the declared level the two-mode line's saturation s = 32 at tau_P = 8 gives 0.485, the blind's R = share_P / tau_P = 0.0606

the credit's count per family: the fluorescence row's count rises by one per giving and falls by one per credit, so an empty wave is credited by no counter and the dark bins read 0 whatever the accumulated levels show
the output: one `credit` line per credited quantum (family, region, window), read per window as the bin's count; the back-in-time gate exact between clicks and across a click from the click line
